about: Warranty sources by manufacturer. 'match' is a regex on the BIOS/WMI manufacturer. Automatic methods talk only to the manufacturer's own services (never a third-party proxy: client serials stay between DE and the OEM). 'manual' vendors give the technician the check page; the end date they record is stored with who recorded it. API keys are runtime secrets, never stored. Entries marked confirmed:false have not been verified against the vendor's current documentation.

vendors.name: Dell
vendors.note: Request API access in Dell TechDirect (Warranty API). Without the key the tool falls back to the check page.

vendors.name: Lenovo
vendors.note: Lenovo's public support site; the warranty page carries the base and extended warranties as JSON (ds_warranties).

vendors.name: HP
vendors.note: HP's warranty API is for approved HP partners only; open HP's check page with the serial and record the end date (Scan & fix > Warranty).

vendors.name: Microsoft Surface
vendors.note: No public Surface warranty API. Business devices: Surface Management Portal or the business service site.

vendors.name: Apple
vendors.note: Apple's coverage page needs a CAPTCHA; there is no public API.

vendors.name: Framework
vendors.note: Framework warranty runs from the order date; use the order record.
